en: Yes, students without a physical ID are usually allowed during the first month of the school year, especially first-year students who do not have their ID yet.
You can present your validated COR to the entrance guard so they can verify that you are an officially enrolled first-year student.
Make sure it is a validated COR, and explain clearly why you do not have your student ID yet.
If you lost your student ID, ask the guard about the entry process and explain why your ID is missing. Make sure to bring your validated COR.
If you only forgot your student ID, it is better to go back and bring it. If that is not possible, ask the guard if there is another way to enter temporarily.
Always bring your student ID when entering campus. If you do not have one yet, process your student ID at the University Press.
ceb: Oo, kasagaran allowed ang students nga wala pay physical ID sulod sa unang bulan sa school year, labi na ang first-year students nga wala pa nakakuha sa ilang ID.
Pwede nimo ipakita ang imong validated COR sa entrance guard aron ma-verify nila nga officially enrolled first-year student ka.
Siguroa nga validated COR kini, ug taronga og explain nganong wala pa kay student ID.
Kung nawala imong student ID, pangutana sa guard bahin sa entry process ug isulti nganong nawala imong ID. Siguroa nga dala nimo ang imong validated COR.
Kung nabilin ra nimo imong student ID, mas maayo nga balikan nimo ug dad-on. Kung dili na mahimo, pangutana sa guard kung naa bay temporary way nga makasulod.
Kanunay dad-a imong student ID kung mosulod sa campus. Kung wala pa kay ID, iprocess imong student ID sa University Press.

en: What is BukSU's policy on haircut and colored hair?
According to the BukSU Student Handbook guidelines on grooming and campus decorum:
1. Students are expected to maintain neat, clean, and respectable hairstyles while on campus.
2. For male students in general undergraduate programs, modest and well-groomed haircuts are expected. Extreme or unkempt styles are discouraged.

3. **Board Courses & Clinical Programs**: Programs such as the **College of Nursing (CON)** and **College of Education (COE)** during teaching internships enforce strict professional grooming rules — including natural hair color (no loud/unnatural hair dye) and standard military/prescribed hair cuts for males.
4. Modest hair highlights are generally permitted in non-board programs as long as they adhere to general university decorum.
ceb: Unsa ang patakaran sa BukSU bahin sa haircut ug colored hair?
Sumala sa BukSU Student Handbook guidelines sa grooming ug campus decorum:
1. Ang mga estudyante gilauman nga magmintinar og hapsay, limpyo, ug desente nga estilo sa buhok sulod sa campus.
2. Para sa mga lalaki sa regular nga undergraduate programs, gikinahanglan ang disente ug hapsay nga tupi. Ang sobra o unkempt nga estilo dili girekomenda.

3. **Board Courses & Clinical Programs**: Ang mga kurso sama sa **College of Nursing (CON)** ug **College of Education (COE)** panahon sa internship nagpatuman og estrikto nga grooming rules — lakip ang natural nga kolor sa buhok (bawal ang hayag/unnatural nga hair dye) ug standard prescribed haircut para sa mga lalaki.
4. Ang natural o modest nga hair highlights kasagarang gitugotan sa mga non-board programs basta subay sa kinatibuk-ang university decorum.

en: How do students connect to the official BukSU campus Wi-Fi?
To connect to the university student Wi-Fi network:
Step 1: Turn on your device's Wi-Fi and connect to the **'BukSU-Student'** network.
Step 2: A captive portal / login page will automatically open (or open your browser and navigate to any web page).
Step 3: Log in using your **BukSU Institutional Email Account** (@student.buksu.edu.ph) and password.
Step 4: Once authenticated, you will have access to campus internet services.
Note: If you have not yet claimed your institutional email, or if your login is not working, visit the **ICT Service Unit (ICTU)** on the 2nd Floor of the CPAG Building.
ceb: Unsaon pag-connect sa campus Wi-Fi sa BukSU para sa mga estudyante?
Aron maka-connect sa university student Wi-Fi network:
Hakbang 1: I-on ang Wi-Fi sa imong cellphone o laptop ug pilia ang **'BukSU-Student'** network.
Hakbang 2: Awtomatikong moabli ang login portal (o ablihi ang imong browser aron mogawas ang portal).
Hakbang 3: Pag-login gamit ang imong **BukSU Institutional Email Account** (@student.buksu.edu.ph) ug password.
Hakbang 4: Human sa malampusong pag-login, aduna na kay access sa campus internet.
Hinumdomi: Kung wala pa nimo makuha ang imong institutional email o naay problema sa login, adtoa ang **ICT Service Unit (ICTU)** sa 2nd Floor sa CPAG Building.

en: The Orientation Program is designed to introduce new students to the university’s mission, vision, and academic policies. Its primary goal is to help you adjust to campus life and understand the essential academic expectations of Bukidnon State University.

During this session, you will learn about critical university policies, such as Incomplete (INC) rules and Failure Due to Absences (FDA) counts. Please note that attending your Departmental Orientation is highly required, as it provides specific guidance for your chosen program.
ceb: Ang Orientation Program gihimo aron ipaila sa mga bag-ong estudyante ang mission, vision, ug academic policies sa unibersidad. Ang pangunang tumong niini mao ang pagtabang kanimo nga maka-adjust sa campus life ug masabtan ang mga importanteng academic expectations sa Bukidnon State University.

Sa maong session, makakat-on ka bahin sa mga importanteng patakaran sa unibersidad, sama sa Incomplete (INC) rules ug Failure Due to Absences (FDA) counts. Palihog hinumdumi nga importante kaayo ang pag-attend sa inyong Departmental Orientation, kay didto ihatag ang mga espesipikong giya para sa imong napiling programa.
